# Clinical and faculty services | RFI 261001

ONOUR IMPRAM VENTURES LTD created this optional browser-based walkthrough to accompany its response to Liverpool John Moores University’s preliminary market engagement.
Published site: https://onourimpram.github.io/ljmu-rfi261001-demo/
Buyer notice: https://www.find-tender.service.gov.uk/Notice/099596-2026

The clinical workspace connects appointments, supervised student notes, progress history and remote follow-up consent. The faculty workspace connects course places, organisational orders, example VAT, credits, receipts, refunds and finance reporting. The evaluation guide links the exercises to the questionnaire.
The demo uses fictional data and local browser storage. The private supplier response describes production status, external integrations, assurance and commercial terms.
